crossRefs.note: My soul is among lions. I lie among those who are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows…
Then Saul’s anger burned against Jonathan, and he said to him, “You son of a perverse rebellious woman, don’t I know…
You, son of man, don’t be afraid of them, neither be afraid of their words, though briers and thorns are with you, and…
“Behold, I send you out as sheep among wolves. Therefore be wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.
A man’s foes will be those of his own household.
For we were also once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy…

translations.web: My soul has had her dwelling too long with him who hates peace.
translations.bsb: Too long have I dwelt among those who hate peace.
translations.kjv: My soul hath long dwelt with him that hateth peace.
translations.asv: My soul hath long had her dwelling With him that hateth peace.
